reference_fields: MSU E-2774 Growing Table Grapes in a Temperate Climate
Michigan State University Extension Bulletin E-2774 on growing table grapes in temperate climates, with variety selection and crop-adjustment guidance based on Michigan and New York experience

locations.name: Southwest Michigan Research and Extension Center, Benton Harbor, Michigan
